meta.name: adversarial-spec
meta.description: Iteratively refine a product spec by debating with multiple LLMs (GPT, Gemini, Grok, etc.) until all models agree. Use when user wants to write or refine a specification document using adversarial development.

copy.tagline: 用多模型辩论迭代优化产品规格文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用AI辩论来打磨产品规格文档
copy.tagline_en: Iteratively refine product specs by debating with multiple LLMs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to polish product specification documents through AI debate

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会引导多个大模型（如 GPT、Gemini）对产品需求或技术文档进行辩论，反复修改直到所有模型达成一致。
howto.when: 当用户想撰写或完善一份产品规格文档，并希望借助多个 AI 模型进行对抗式评审时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份用户登录功能的 PRD，并用多个模型辩论优化。
say.note: Claude 会先收集需求，生成初稿，再启动多模型辩论。

say.text: 用对抗式方法完善这份技术规格书。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件，然后组织模型辩论修改。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates a debate among multiple LLMs (e.g., GPT, Gemini) to iteratively refine a product spec or technical document until all models agree.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to write or improve a specification document using adversarial development with multiple AI models.

say_en.text: Write a PRD for a login feature and refine it through multi-model debate.
say_en.note: Claude will gather requirements, draft, then start debate.

say_en.text: Improve this tech spec using adversarial review.
say_en.note: Claude reads the file and organizes model debate.
